title: Ammonia decomposition reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed reference family for sanity-checking catalyst economics against a specific reaction window. COMET itself remains reaction-agnostic and uses these routes as starting points, not as the product boundary.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward selling cost while keeping route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent, higher-confidence pricing and more reproducible routes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2015
citations.note: Guo and Vlachos model Ni patches on Pt(111) using multiscale simulations; this is Ni-Pt, not Ni-Fe, and does not establish a Ni/alumina recipe. The legacy citation id is retained for compatibility.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2019
citations.note: CoMoFeNiCu high-entropy nanoparticles on carbon nanofibers, with 10 wt% total metals and flash heating to 2000-2300 K; context for composition effects, not evidence for a Ni/MgO-CeO2 or Ni/alumina formulation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2023
citations.note: Ru ensembles on preferentially exposed MgO(111) nanosheets; the reported 3.1 wt% Ru catalyst uses Ru3(CO)12 deposition on a specially prepared support. Generic MgO impregnation is a manufacturing proxy.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Light-driven Ru nanoparticles on GaN nanowires on silicon, including photodeposition and concentrated illumination. This is not a thermal Ru/MgO catalyst recipe or thermal-only activity benchmark.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Photothermal catalyst with 10 wt% Ni on CeO2-x/CNTs (CeO2:CNT mass ratio 0.5), deposited by NaBH4-assisted reduction. It establishes an interface concept, not the screened Ni/CeO2/MgO formulation or its thermal-only performance.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 203874
citations.note: Nickel nitrate hexahydrate procurement anchor with public pack-size pricing.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 206229
citations.note: Ruthenium chloride hydrate procurement anchor with public pack-size pricing.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 63107
citations.note: Magnesium oxide reagent pricing used as a transparent support-price anchor, not a direct industrial support basis.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 211575
citations.note: Cerium oxide public catalog price used as a promoter/support procurement anchor.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 202606
citations.note: Alumina public catalog price used as a transparency anchor while screening cost uses an engineering support proxy.

citations.label: Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2021
citations.note: Ammonia-decomposition review, used as secondary family context. The previously transcribed 92% conversion at 550 C for 5 wt% Co/MgO-La2O3 was not independently reverified in the accessible primary text during the 2026-09-07 audit.

citations.label: Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 2015
citations.note: Primary study of 5 wt% Co impregnated on Mg-La mixed oxides, tested at 300-550 C and atmospheric pressure; Mg/La = 5 is a molar ratio. It does not establish the screened 85/10 wt% MgO/La2O3 split.

citations.label: Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 2020
citations.note: Co/gamma-Al2O3 preparation study; the cobalt-aluminate and particle-size discussion is context for that support, not direct evidence for Co/MgO-La2O3.

route_templates.name: Wet impregnation on oxide support
synthesis: Slurry mixing or incipient wetness loading
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable route for industrial catalyst screening and the easiest baseline to scale.

route_templates.name: Interface-engineered Ni-MgO-CeO2 route
route_templates.route_note: Improves performance without noble metal loading, but route discipline and support engineering are less mature.

route_templates.name: Ru dispersion on basic oxide
synthesis: Low-volume deposition with tight Ru balance
route_templates.route_note: Premium low-temperature route with the clearest activity upside but the highest sensitivity to Ru pricing.

candidates.title: Ni/gamma-Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Non-noble industrial baseline for current-price screening.
decision_notes: The 12/88 wt% Ni/alumina composition and 550-700 C window are engineering screening assumptions; no exact primary recipe was verified.
Ni/Pt(111) simulations and carbon-supported CoMoFeNiCu alloys do not validate this monometallic gamma-alumina baseline. Support grade and precursor markup remain price proxies.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with nitrate-style precursor markup.

Industrial support screening proxy retained to avoid lab-pack alumina distortion. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: Ni-MgO/CeO2 interface
candidates.summary: Engineering Ni/CeO2/MgO formulation inspired by interface design; the cited photothermal Ni-CeO2-x/CNT study uses a different support and activation mode.
decision_notes: The 15/15/70 wt% Ni/CeO2/MgO composition, 475-650 C window and generic oxide route are assumptions, not a reproduced literature recipe.
The primary paper uses 10 wt% Ni, CeO2:CNT = 0.5 by mass, NaBH4-assisted reduction and light; its activity cannot be transferred directly to this thermal MgO formulation.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with precursor markup.
2025 USGS cerium-oxide price used as a bulk support/promoter proxy.

MgO support uses a screening proxy rather than reagent-pack pricing. UN Comtrade 2024 magnesia imports (HS 251990) averaged $0.52/kg (China $0.39/kg; high-purity flows to $4.10/kg), bracketing this proxy from below; Sigma 342793 lab price ($0.38/g) is the packaged ceiling.

candidates.title: Ru/MgO premium
candidates.summary: Ru/MgO screening formulation motivated by active Ru ensembles on MgO(111); catalyst grade and synthesis differ from the generic cost route.
decision_notes: The retained 3 wt% Ru cost input approximates a paper reporting 3.1 wt% Ru on preferential MgO(111) nanosheets, not commodity MgO of unspecified facet distribution.

The primary route includes special MgO preparation and Ru3(CO)12 deposition. The chloride-price anchor and generic impregnation route do not reproduce those procurement and manufacturing requirements.
GaN-supported Ru uses concentrated light and is not direct evidence for thermal Ru/MgO activity. The 400-575 C screening window is not a cross-study performance normalization.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Ru feed tracked on the live/reference metal board with precursor markup.

Support cost kept on an engineering basis even though a public Sigma quote is attached for transparency. UN Comtrade 2024 magnesia imports (HS 251990) averaged $0.52/kg (China $0.39/kg; high-purity flows to $4.10/kg), bracketing this proxy from below; Sigma 342793 lab price ($0.38/g) is the packaged ceiling.

candidates.title: Co/MgO-La2O3 mid-cost route
candidates.summary: Co/Mg-La mixed-oxide screening route supported by a primary study of 5 wt% Co; the support mass split and comparisons with other catalyst families remain assumptions.
decision_notes: The primary study supports 5 wt% Co and identifies Mg/La = 5 on a molar basis as its most active support; the retained 85 wt% MgO and 10 wt% La2O3 are not that formulation.
The review-derived 92% conversion was not reverified against the primary results and is not assigned to this proxy. Co/alumina spinel observations are not direct evidence for this Mg-La support.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.
